title: Fix example build scripts for @objectstack/cli 1.1.0
body:
`@objectstack/cli` 1.1.0 changed `compile` from two positional args to one arg + `-o` option. The default output is `dist/objectstack.json`, so the second arg just needs to be dropped.

```diff
- "build": "objectstack compile objectstack.config.ts dist/objectstack.json"
+ "build": "objectstack compile objectstack.config.ts"
```

- Updated build scripts in `examples/kitchen-sink`, `examples/crm`, and `examples/todo`
